archimate:ApplicationService.name: Patient History Aggregation Service
archimate:ApplicationService.documentation:
A Patient History Aggregation Service is a data-consolidation system that retrieves, cleans, and merges a patient's historical medical records from multiple disparate sources—such as different clinics, labs, and hospitals—into a single, unified longitudinal health record.
Its purpose is to provide clinicians with a complete, chronological view of a patient’s medical history, eliminating clinical blind spots and preventing redundant testing or dangerous treatment conflicts.
Example: When a new patient visits an urgent care clinic, this service automatically gathers their past diagnoses from a family practice, laboratory results from an external testing center, and recent imaging reports from a local hospital to present a single, cohesive timeline.
